concurrent_parent_insertion:
A content hash does not establish rung~3. In a deterministic source-function
test, the first operator instruction was ``OBL-01: preserve the existing
acceptance criteria.'' Four unrelated operator requests and eight assistant
messages followed it. The handoff brief retained the later messages but not
that instruction; the capsule's hash still recomputed correctly
(Figure~\ref{fig:stp-handoff-coverage}). This is a selection failure before any
successor acts, not an observed rate of agent noncompliance.

\input{figures/fig-stp-handoff-coverage}

Coverage was checked against a separate record of required source-turn IDs
and exact instruction text, not requirements inferred from the shortened
brief. That synthetic check is not a general obligation extractor. The full
capsule retained a transcript reference, so authorized retrieval might recover
what the brief omits; neither access nor recovery was tested. A matching hash
also says nothing about who authored the selected records.
